traditional: A soft contact. Action, conflict, and heat supports growth, fortune, and patronage - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. The benefic Jupiter tempers the malefic Mars.
modern: Energy meets expansion. Strong drive, confidence, and enthusiasm, sometimes to the point of recklessness. The sextile makes this a natural strength: High energy directed toward real accomplishment. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize drive and growth into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what drive and growth have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: A quick pitch catches fire and reaches a much larger audience than expected. Mars sextile Jupiter can help one direct move open a bigger opportunity, especially when a short video, sharp headline, introduction, or application reaches the right person at the right time. Attention is useful, but it creates expectations immediately. Make sure somebody is ready to answer the replies, fulfill the orders, or follow the lead. The opportunity gets better when the team can actually support the visibility it asked for.
